imo-1979-q1.summary: Let $p,q$ be positive integers satisfying $$\frac pq=1-\frac12+\frac13-\frac14+\cdots-\frac1{1318}+\frac1{1319}.$$ Prove that $1979\mid p$.
imo-1979-q1.summaryZh: 设正整数 $p,q$ 满足 $$\frac pq=1-\frac12+\frac13-\frac14+\cdots-\frac1{1318}+\frac1{1319}.$$ 证明 $1979\mid p$。

methods.title: Pair complementary denominators modulo 1979
methods.titleZh: 按模 1979 配对互补分母
steps: Subtract the even terms twice from the harmonic sum: $$\frac pq=\sum_{k=1}^{1319}\frac1k-2\sum_{j=1}^{659}\frac1{2j}=\sum_{k=660}^{1319}\frac1k.$$

The integers from $660$ through $1319$ split into the pairs $k$ and $1979-k$, where $660\le k\le989$. Hence $$\frac pq=\sum_{k=660}^{989}\left(\frac1k+\frac1{1979-k}\right)=1979\sum_{k=660}^{989}\frac1{k(1979-k)}.\tag{1}$$
Let $D=\prod_{j=660}^{1319}j$. For every pair in (1), $D/[k(1979-k)]$ is an integer. Thus, for some integer $A$, equation (1) becomes $$pD=1979qA.$$
The number $1979$ is prime: $\sqrt{1979}<45$, and none of the primes at most $43$ divides it. Every factor of $D$ lies strictly between $0$ and $1979$, so $1979\nmid D$.
Since the prime $1979$ divides $pD$ but does not divide $D$, Euclid's lemma gives $1979\mid p$. Notice that the argument does not require $p/q$ to have been reduced.
stepsZh: 把偶数项从调和和中减去两次：$$\frac pq=\sum_{k=1}^{1319}\frac1k-2\sum_{j=1}^{659}\frac1{2j}=\sum_{k=660}^{1319}\frac1k$$。
令 $D=\prod_{j=660}^{1319}j$。对式 (1) 中每一对分母，$D/[k(1979-k)]$ 都是整数。因此存在整数 $A$，使得 $$pD=1979qA$$。
$1979$ 是素数：$\sqrt{1979}<45$，逐一检验不超过 $43$ 的素数可知它们都不能整除 $1979$。而 $D$ 的每个因子都严格小于 $1979$，所以 $1979\nmid D$。
素数 $1979$ 整除 $pD$ 而不整除 $D$，由欧几里得引理得到 $1979\mid p$。该论证并不要求 $p/q$ 已经约成最简分数。

imo-1979-q2.summary: The top and bottom faces of a prism are pentagons $A_1A_2A_3A_4A_5$ and $B_1B_2B_3B_4B_5$. Every side of these pentagons and every segment $A_iB_j$ is colored red or green. No triangle whose three sides are among these colored segments is monochromatic. Prove that all ten pentagon sides have one color.
imo-1979-q2.summaryZh: 一个棱柱的上、下底面分别是五边形 $A_1A_2A_3A_4A_5$ 与 $B_1B_2B_3B_4B_5$。两个五边形的每条边以及每条线段 $A_iB_j$ 均被染成红色或绿色。任何三条边均已染色的三角形都不是单色三角形。证明两个五边形的十条边颜色全部相同。
imo-1979-q2.answer: All five top edges and all five bottom edges have the same color.
imo-1979-q2.answerZh: 上、下底面的十条边具有同一种颜色。

methods.title: Use majority cross-edges and exclude monochromatic triangles
methods.titleZh: 利用跨层边的多数颜色排除单色三角形
steps: Read all subscripts modulo $5$. Any three vertices of a pentagon include two adjacent vertices: otherwise the successor of each selected vertex would be a distinct unselected vertex, requiring at least six vertices.

Fix $A_i$. Among the five cross-edges $A_iB_j$, at least three share a color $c$. Two of their bottom endpoints are adjacent, say $B_j,B_{j+1}$. To avoid a monochromatic triangle, $B_jB_{j+1}$ has the other color $d$.

Let $A_k$ be either neighbor of $A_i$ on the top pentagon. If $A_iA_k$ had color $c$, then the triangles $A_iA_kB_j$ and $A_iA_kB_{j+1}$ would force both $A_kB_j$ and $A_kB_{j+1}$ to have color $d$. Together with the $d$-colored edge $B_jB_{j+1}$, these would form a monochromatic triangle. Therefore both top edges incident with $A_i$ have color $d$.
The choice of $A_i$ was arbitrary. Thus, at every top vertex, its two incident top edges have the same color; going around the five-cycle shows that all top edges have one color. Call it red.

For any bottom vertex $B_j$, at most two cross-edges $B_jA_i$ are red. Otherwise three red neighbors among the five top vertices would contain an adjacent pair, and that red top edge would complete a red triangle. Hence every $B_j$ has at least three green neighbors on top.

For a bottom edge $B_jB_{j+1}$, the two sets of green top neighbors each have at least three elements, so they intersect because $3+3>5$. A common neighbor $A_i$ gives two green sides of the triangle $A_iB_jB_{j+1}$; consequently its third side $B_jB_{j+1}$ must be red. Every bottom edge is therefore red as well.
stepsZh: 以下下标均按模 $5$ 理解。五边形的任意三个顶点中必有两个相邻；否则每个所选顶点的后继都是互不相同的未选顶点，这将至少需要六个顶点。
固定 $A_i$。五条跨层边 $A_iB_j$ 中至少有三条同色，记为颜色 $c$。它们的下层端点中有两个相邻，不妨为 $B_j,B_{j+1}$。为避免单色三角形，边 $B_jB_{j+1}$ 必须为另一种颜色 $d$。
设 $A_k$ 是上层五边形中 $A_i$ 的任一相邻顶点。若 $A_iA_k$ 的颜色为 $c$，则三角形 $A_iA_kB_j$ 与 $A_iA_kB_{j+1}$ 分别迫使 $A_kB_j,A_kB_{j+1}$ 都为颜色 $d$。再结合颜色为 $d$ 的边 $B_jB_{j+1}$，便得到单色三角形，矛盾。因此与 $A_i$ 相连的两条上层边都为颜色 $d$。
$A_i$ 的选取是任意的，所以在上层五边形的每个顶点处，两条相邻边颜色相同。沿五边形依次传递可知五条上层边全部同色，不妨称为红色。
对任一下层顶点 $B_j$，红色跨层边 $B_jA_i$ 至多有两条。否则三个红色上层邻点中必有一对相邻，它们之间的上层红边会与 $B_j$ 构成红色三角形。因此每个 $B_j$ 至少有三个绿色上层邻点。
对任一下层边 $B_jB_{j+1}$，两个端点的绿色上层邻点集合大小均至少为 $3$，而 $3+3>5$，故二者必有公共点 $A_i$。三角形 $A_iB_jB_{j+1}$ 已有两条绿色边，所以第三条边 $B_jB_{j+1}$ 必为红色。故所有下层边也都是红色。

imo-1979-q3.summary: Two intersecting circles contain a common point $A$. Two moving points start together at $A$, one on each circle, travel at constant speeds in the same orientation, and each completes one revolution in the same time. Prove that some fixed point $P$ is always equidistant from the two moving points.
imo-1979-q3.summaryZh: 两个相交圆有公共点 $A$。两个动点同时从 $A$ 出发，各自在一个圆上以恒定速度沿相同方向运动，并在相同时间内各完成一周。证明：平面内存在一个定点 $P$，它在任意时刻到两个动点的距离都相等。
imo-1979-q3.answer: If the centres are $O_1,O_2$, one may take $P$ to be the reflection of $A$ across the perpendicular bisector of $O_1O_2$.
imo-1979-q3.answerZh: 若两圆圆心为 $O_1,O_2$，可取 $P$ 为 $A$ 关于线段 $O_1O_2$ 垂直平分线的对称点。

methods.title: Reflect one motion and compare two rotations
methods.titleZh: 反射其中一个运动并比较两个旋转
steps: Let the circle centres be $O_1,O_2$ and the common revolution time be $T$. At time $t$, both moving radii have turned through the same signed angle $\theta=2\pi t/T$, because the motions have the same orientation. Denote the moving points by $X,Y$.
If $O_1=O_2$, the two circles coincide because they both contain $A$; then $X=Y$ at all times and any fixed $P$ works. Assume $O_1\ne O_2$.

Let $s$ be reflection across the perpendicular bisector of $O_1O_2$, and put $P=s(A)$. Write $X'=s(X)$. Reflection sends $O_1$ to $O_2$ and reverses directed angles, so $X'$ is obtained from $P$ by a rotation of angle $-\theta$ about $O_2$.
Consequently the rotation of angle $\theta$ about $O_2$ sends $X'$ to $P$. The same rotation sends $A$ to $Y$. Since rotations preserve distance, $$AX'=PY.$$
Reflection sends $P$ to $A$ and $X$ to $X'$, so it also gives $PX=AX'$. Combining the two equalities yields $$PX=PY$$ for every time $t$.
stepsZh: 设两圆圆心为 $O_1,O_2$，共同的绕行周期为 $T$。在时刻 $t$，由于两个运动方向相同，两条运动半径都转过同一个有向角 $\theta=2\pi t/T$。记两个动点为 $X,Y$。
若 $O_1=O_2$，两个圆又都经过 $A$，故两圆重合；此时始终有 $X=Y$，任意定点 $P$ 都满足要求。以下设 $O_1\ne O_2$。
设 $s$ 为关于 $O_1O_2$ 垂直平分线的轴对称，并令 $P=s(A)$、$X'=s(X)$。该对称把 $O_1$ 映到 $O_2$，同时反转有向角，所以 $X'$ 是把 $P$ 绕 $O_2$ 旋转 $-\theta$ 所得的点。
因此，绕 $O_2$ 旋转 $\theta$ 会把 $X'$ 映到 $P$；同一个旋转把 $A$ 映到 $Y$。旋转保持距离，所以 $$AX'=PY$$。
另一方面，轴对称把 $P$ 映到 $A$、把 $X$ 映到 $X'$，所以 $PX=AX'$。合并两式得到任意时刻均有 $$PX=PY$$。

imo-1979-q4.summary: The official English paper contains the undefined symbol $A$ in $(QP+PA)/QR$. Using the standard correction $PA\to PR$: a point $P$ lies in a plane $\pi$, while $Q\notin\pi$. Determine all $R\in\pi$ maximizing $$\frac{QP+PR}{QR}.$$
imo-1979-q4.summaryZh: 官方英文试卷把比值印成 $(QP+PA)/QR$，其中 $A$ 未定义。采用公认勘误 $PA\to PR$：点 $P$ 位于平面 $\pi$ 内，点 $Q\notin\pi$。求使 $$\frac{QP+PR}{QR}$$ 最大的所有平面内点 $R$。
imo-1979-q4.answer: Let $H$ be the perpendicular projection of $Q$ onto $\pi$. If $P\ne H$, the unique maximizer lies beyond $H$ on ray $PH$ and satisfies $PR=PQ$. If $P=H$, every point of the circle in $\pi$ centred at $P$ with radius $PQ$ is a maximizer. The maximum is $\sqrt{2PQ/(PQ-PH)}$.
imo-1979-q4.answerZh: 设 $H$ 为 $Q$ 在 $\pi$ 上的垂足。若 $P\ne H$，唯一最大点位于射线 $PH$ 上且越过 $H$，并满足 $PR=PQ$；若 $P=H$，所有最大点组成平面 $\pi$ 内以 $P$ 为圆心、$PQ$ 为半径的圆。最大值为 $\sqrt{2PQ/(PQ-PH)}$。

methods.title: Project to the plane and optimize by Cauchy-Schwarz
methods.titleZh: 作垂直投影并用柯西不等式优化
steps: Let $H$ be the foot of the perpendicular from $Q$ to $\pi$, and write $$a=PQ,\qquad d=PH,\qquad h=QH>0.$$ The right triangle $QHP$ gives $a^2=d^2+h^2$, hence $a>d$.
For $R\in\pi$, put $t=HR$. Then $$QR=\sqrt{h^2+t^2},\qquad PR\le PH+HR=d+t.$$ Therefore $$\frac{QP+PR}{QR}\le\frac{a+d+t}{\sqrt{h^2+t^2}}.$$

Apply Cauchy-Schwarz to the numerator: $$a+d+t=\frac{a+d}{h}h+1\cdot t\le\sqrt{\frac{(a+d)^2}{h^2}+1}\sqrt{h^2+t^2}.$$ Since $h^2=a^2-d^2$, the ratio is at most $$\sqrt{\frac{(a+d)^2+h^2}{h^2}}=\sqrt{\frac{2a}{a-d}}.$$

Equality in Cauchy-Schwarz requires $$t=\frac{h^2}{a+d}=a-d.$$ If $d>0$, equality in $PR\le d+t$ further requires $P,H,R$ to be collinear with $H$ between $P$ and $R$. Thus there is one maximizing point: the point beyond $H$ on ray $PH$ with $HR=a-d$, equivalently $PR=a=PQ$.

If $d=0$, then $P=H$ and $PR=HR=t$, so the triangle inequality step is always an equality. The remaining equality condition is $t=a=PQ$. Hence the maximizing points are exactly the circle in $\pi$ with centre $P$ and radius $PQ$.
stepsZh: 设 $H$ 为 $Q$ 到平面 $\pi$ 的垂足，并记 $$a=PQ,\qquad d=PH,\qquad h=QH>0$$。直角三角形 $QHP$ 给出 $a^2=d^2+h^2$，故 $a>d$。
对任意 $R\in\pi$，令 $t=HR$。则 $$QR=\sqrt{h^2+t^2},\qquad PR\le PH+HR=d+t$$。因而 $$\frac{QP+PR}{QR}\le\frac{a+d+t}{\sqrt{h^2+t^2}}$$。
对分子使用柯西不等式：$$a+d+t=\frac{a+d}{h}h+1\cdot t\le\sqrt{\frac{(a+d)^2}{h^2}+1}\sqrt{h^2+t^2}$$。又因 $h^2=a^2-d^2$，所求比值不超过 $$\sqrt{\frac{(a+d)^2+h^2}{h^2}}=\sqrt{\frac{2a}{a-d}}$$。
柯西不等式取等要求 $$t=\frac{h^2}{a+d}=a-d$$。若 $d>0$，要使 $PR\le d+t$ 也取等，还须 $P,H,R$ 共线且 $H$ 位于 $P,R$ 之间。因此唯一最大点是射线 $PH$ 上越过 $H$ 且满足 $HR=a-d$ 的点；等价地，$PR=a=PQ$。
若 $d=0$，则 $P=H$ 且 $PR=HR=t$，三角不等式恒取等。剩余等号条件为 $t=a=PQ$，所以全部最大点恰为平面 $\pi$ 内以 $P$ 为圆心、$PQ$ 为半径的圆。

imo-1979-q5.summary: Determine all real numbers $a$ for which there exist nonnegative real numbers $x_1,\ldots,x_5$ satisfying $$\sum_{k=1}^5kx_k=a,\qquad\sum_{k=1}^5k^3x_k=a^2,\qquad\sum_{k=1}^5k^5x_k=a^3.$$
imo-1979-q5.summaryZh: 求所有实数 $a$，使得存在非负实数 $x_1,\ldots,x_5$ 满足 $$\sum_{k=1}^5kx_k=a,\qquad\sum_{k=1}^5k^3x_k=a^2,\qquad\sum_{k=1}^5k^5x_k=a^3$$。

methods.title: Form a weighted sum of nonnegative squares
methods.titleZh: 构造非负平方项的加权和
steps: The first equation and $x_k\ge0$ imply $a\ge0$. The value $a=0$ works by taking every $x_k=0$.
Assume $a>0$. Combine the three equations in the form $$\begin{aligned}\sum_{k=1}^5kx_k(k^2-a)^2&=\sum k^5x_k-2a\sum k^3x_k+a^2\sum kx_k\\&=a^3-2a^3+a^3=0.\end{aligned}$$

Every summand $kx_k(k^2-a)^2$ is nonnegative. Since $\sum kx_k=a>0$, at least one $x_m$ is positive. For that index, the corresponding zero summand forces $m^2-a=0$. Therefore $$a=m^2\in\{1,4,9,16,25\}.$$

Conversely, for any $m\in\{1,2,3,4,5\}$, set $a=m^2$, $x_m=m$, and $x_k=0$ for $k\ne m$. The three sums become $m^2,m^4,m^6$, respectively, so all five positive listed values occur. Together with $a=0$, this completes the answer.
stepsZh: 由第一式及 $x_k\ge0$ 可知 $a\ge0$。取所有 $x_k=0$ 时，$a=0$ 确实可行。
以下设 $a>0$。把三个方程组合为 $$\begin{aligned}\sum_{k=1}^5kx_k(k^2-a)^2&=\sum k^5x_k-2a\sum k^3x_k+a^2\sum kx_k\\&=a^3-2a^3+a^3=0.\end{aligned}$$
每一项 $kx_k(k^2-a)^2$ 都非负。又因为 $\sum kx_k=a>0$，至少有一个 $x_m>0$。对应的和式项等于零，迫使 $m^2-a=0$。故 $$a=m^2\in\{1,4,9,16,25\}$$。
反过来，对任意 $m\in\{1,2,3,4,5\}$，取 $a=m^2$、$x_m=m$，其余 $x_k=0$。三个和依次为 $m^2,m^4,m^6$，所以五个正数值均可达到。再加上 $a=0$，即得到全部答案。

imo-1979-q6.summary: In a regular octagon, $A$ and $E$ are opposite vertices. A frog starts at $A$, jumps only to adjacent vertices, and stops permanently on first reaching $E$. Let $a_n$ be the number of admissible paths of exactly $n$ jumps ending at $E$. Prove that $a_{2n-1}=0$ and $$a_{2n}=\frac{(2+\sqrt2)^{n-1}-(2-\sqrt2)^{n-1}}{\sqrt2}\qquad(n\ge1).$$
imo-1979-q6.summaryZh: 在正八边形中，$A,E$ 是一对对顶点。青蛙从 $A$ 出发，每次只跳到相邻顶点，并在第一次到达 $E$ 后永久停止。设 $a_n$ 为恰用 $n$ 次跳跃到达 $E$ 的允许路径数。证明 $a_{2n-1}=0$，且 $$a_{2n}=\frac{(2+\sqrt2)^{n-1}-(2-\sqrt2)^{n-1}}{\sqrt2}\qquad(n\ge1)$$。

methods.title: Reduce the walk to a two-state recurrence
methods.titleZh: 把路径计数化为二状态递推
steps: Label the vertices $A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H$ cyclically. Each jump switches between the two parity classes $\{A,C,E,G\}$ and $\{B,D,F,H\}$. Since $A,E$ are in the same class, every path from $A$ to $E$ has even length; hence $a_{2n-1}=0$.

For $m\ge0$, count length-$2m$ partial paths that start at $A$ and have not visited $E$. Let $u_m$ count those ending at $A$, and let $v_m$ count together those ending at $C$ or $G$. Initially $u_0=1$ and $v_0=0$.

Extending by two jumps while still avoiding $E$ gives $$u_{m+1}=2u_m+v_m,\qquad v_{m+1}=2u_m+2v_m.\tag{1}$$ Indeed, from $A$ there are two returns to $A$ and two routes to $C$ or $G$; from either $C$ or $G$ there is one route to $A$, two returns to the same endpoint class, and one excluded route reaching $E$.

Every partial path counted by $v_m$ has exactly one two-jump extension reaching $E$, through $D$ from $C$ or through $F$ from $G$. Conversely every admissible length-$2m+2$ path has such a prefix. Thus $$a_{2m+2}=v_m.\tag{2}$$
Eliminating $u_m$ from (1) yields $$v_{m+2}=4v_{m+1}-2v_m,\qquad v_0=0,\quad v_1=2.\tag{3}$$ The characteristic roots are $x=2+\sqrt2$ and $y=2-\sqrt2$.
The sequence $w_m=(x^m-y^m)/\sqrt2$ satisfies (3), with $w_0=0$ and $w_1=2$. Hence $v_m=w_m$. Substituting $m=n-1$ into (2) gives the required formula for $a_{2n}$.
stepsZh: 按顺序把正八边形顶点记为 $A,B,C,D,E,F,G,H$。每次跳跃都会在两类顶点 $\{A,C,E,G\}$ 与 $\{B,D,F,H\}$ 之间切换。$A,E$ 属于同一类，所以从 $A$ 到 $E$ 的路径长度必为偶数，从而 $a_{2n-1}=0$。
对 $m\ge0$，考虑从 $A$ 出发、恰跳 $2m$ 次且尚未到达 $E$ 的部分路径。设其中终点为 $A$ 的路径数为 $u_m$，终点为 $C$ 或 $G$ 的路径总数为 $v_m$。初值为 $u_0=1,v_0=0$。
在继续避开 $E$ 的条件下延长两步，得到 $$u_{m+1}=2u_m+v_m,\qquad v_{m+1}=2u_m+2v_m.\tag{1}$$ 从 $A$ 出发，两条两步路径回到 $A$，两条到达 $C$ 或 $G$；从 $C$ 或 $G$ 出发，一条到 $A$，两条回到同一终点类别，另有一条因到达 $E$ 而被排除。
每条计入 $v_m$ 的部分路径都恰有一种两步延伸到达 $E$：从 $C$ 经 $D$，或从 $G$ 经 $F$。反过来，每条长度为 $2m+2$ 的允许路径都有这样的前缀。因此 $$a_{2m+2}=v_m.\tag{2}$$
从式 (1) 消去 $u_m$，得到 $$v_{m+2}=4v_{m+1}-2v_m,\qquad v_0=0,\quad v_1=2.\tag{3}$$ 其特征根为 $x=2+\sqrt2$ 与 $y=2-\sqrt2$。
数列 $w_m=(x^m-y^m)/\sqrt2$ 满足式 (3)，且 $w_0=0,w_1=2$。故 $v_m=w_m$。在式 (2) 中取 $m=n-1$，即得题设 $a_{2n}$ 的公式。
